Here are some major office furniture brand websites across different categories:

## **Premium/High-End Brands**
- **Herman Miller** - www.hermanmiller.com
- **Steelcase** - www.steelcase.com
- **Knoll** - www.knoll.com
- **Haworth** - www.haworth.com
- **Humanscale** - www.humanscale.com

## **Mid-Range Commercial Brands**
- **HON** - www.hon.com
- **Global Furniture Group** - www.globalfurnituregroup.com
- **Teknion** - www.teknion.com
- **KI** - www.ki.com
- **Allsteel** - www.allsteeloffice.com

## **Budget-Friendly/Retail Brands**
- **IKEA Business** - www.ikea.com/us/en/ikea-business/
- **Staples** - www.staples.com
- **Office Depot/OfficeMax** - www.officedepot.com
- **Bush Business Furniture** - www.bushbusinessfurniture.com

## **Specialized/Ergonomic Brands**
- **Ergotron** - www.ergotron.com
- **Varidesk (now Vari)** - www.vari.com
- **Uplift Desk** - www.upliftdesk.com
- **Fully** - www.fully.com

- **USM** - www.usm.com

These websites typically offer product catalogs, design tools, dealer locators, and resources for space planning.
